texts390.text: Mine the city. Pray the grid stays on.
An idle mining game on Robinhood Chain. Build your farm in a city run by AI.
Packs, farms and rewards on chain
Block 88443830 · Oct 14, 2026, 4:37 PM · reads without a wallet
Spot price from the market hook
Launch window ended · normal rewards share
Normal pool fee: 1.25% in addition to the displayed hook share. Stability changes event od
Your first farm starts here. Connect a wallet to start mining.
Buy with the game token, or choose Buy with ETH in one click. Reveal your hardware.
Install items, build combos and mine. Buy rooms 2–4 with tokens when you need more space.
Watch the dispatcher. Repair worn items to restore output and keep your farm online.
Build with twelve hardware types in five rarities.
Illustrated rarity examples. Every item can drop in any unlocked rarity.
The swarm sends a letter. Your farm feels the consequences.
The district goes dark. Off-grid combos keep some mining alive.
“Resident. Your lights are a privilege. Service will return when we decide.”
Hot hardware takes damage. Build your cooling before the heat arrives.
“We noticed the smoke. We filed it under: expected behavior.”
Renewable power flows in. Your district gets a welcome mining boost.
“A surplus has been authorized. Try not to get used to it.”
The city is alive. Its operators aren’t human.
The IMD swarm operates the city’s power grid. It dispatches events, watches the districts
You build the farm. The swarm keeps you on your toes.
The BLACKOUT game token launched through IMD on Robinhood Chain. The launch clock, pack op
No max buy limit. All launch tax goes to the reward pool.
Pack opening begins one hour after token launch. Check the live opening time on Packs.
Do I need a wallet to play?
Your farm starts with a pack.
Real assets. Wallet signatures required. No guaranteed rewards.
